prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE hairstyle concept comparison sheet for the Animasters modular avatar game, for owner review before production assets are made.
Input images: Image 1 is the existing bald avatar reference: preserve its exact rounded head, peach skin, prominent small ears, short gray T-shirt torso, front-facing orthographic proportions, matte vinyl-toy 3D material and soft lighting. Image 2 and Image 3 are existing hairstyle references: use ONLY their chunky sculpted locks, charcoal gray color and material, do not repeat their spiky or bob silhouettes.
Primary request: Create a polished 3-column by 2-row contact sheet of SIX distinctly different NEW hairstyle alternatives, each shown worn by the same avatar. These are six design studies within ONE sheet. All six avatars must have the SAME friendly face: two plain tall dark oval eyes with tiny white highlights and a simple small smiling mouth. Same head size, head height, front view, body size, lighting and charcoal hair color in every cell. No accessories or hats.
Subject order, left to right then top to bottom:
1. "01 · Curtains" — short center-parted hair with two broad flowing curtain sections above the eyebrows, a visible center notch, compact sides, ears visible. Not a chin-length bob.
2. "02 · Swept undercut" — asymmetrical side-swept sculpted top, clearly short cropped sides, large readable sweeping wave on top. No shaved-line graphics.
3. "03 · Rounded curls" — a generous round silhouette of chunky sculpted curls, with large soft coils framing the top and sides, airy afro-like volume, face clearly visible; no individual photorealistic fibers.
4. "04 · High ponytail" — swept-back crown with a small clean fringe and ONE high ponytail clearly visible rising above and curling down beside the head. Front view must reveal the ponytail silhouette. Plain charcoal hair tie only.
5. "05 · Twin tails" — TWO long, chunky tied ponytails extending symmetrically down beside the head toward the shoulders, soft separated bangs and small charcoal ties. Clearly distinct from the existing twin buns.
6. "06 · Long layers" — long flowing straight-to-gently-wavy hair to the shoulders, center-parted with two distinct face-framing locks, layered tips and exposed eyes.
Composition: landscape 3:2 sheet, six equally sized spacious cells with generous outer margins. Avatars approximately fill each cell with full hairstyles and full short torso visible, no clipping, no overlap. Hair should stay above eyebrow line except the two face-framing side locks; preserve visibility of both eyes. Very pale warm neutral studio background. Dark neutral crisp small sans-serif labels centered underneath each avatar, using the exact six labels above. No headings, no other text, no UI chrome.
Style: match the existing game assets closely, softly sculpted matte 3D toy hair with broad restrained highlights, simple low-detail locks readable at 56px avatars. No anime face drawings, no pixel art, no photorealism, no flat vector art, no wire strands, no glossy plastic, no logos, no props, no multicolor streaks.
This is a concept sheet for comparing hairstyles, not an asset atlas.
status: Concept alternatives awaiting owner selection; not production hair sprites.
